description:
Umbrella for repeating the DuckDB version-matrix experiment for Polars, to show what the Polars 2.0.0 release (2026-10-06) changed. It closes when every pvm-* step item is done.

Objective: a reproducible, correctness-checked comparison of polars-df on TPC-H, TPC-DS, SSB and ClickBench across selected Polars versions, separating the change of default engine in 2.0 from real engine improvements.

Prior art (extend):
- The DuckDB matrix: scripts/run_duckdb_version_matrix.py and scripts/analyze_duckdb_version_matrix.py (#1946).
- 28 median bundles in results-data/bundles/duckdb-version-matrix/, documented in results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md.
- The cross-surface equivalence gates in benchbox/core/equivalence/cross_surface.py.

Design: three engine setups.
- A: each version's default collect(), which is in-memory on 1.x and streaming with out-of-core spill on 2.0.
- B: 2.0.0 forced in-memory.
- C: streaming against streaming, where supported.
Only setup A is a corpus candidate.

Sequence and gates:
1. pvm-d0 (external review or a recorded waiver, plus the user's approval to begin implementation)
2. pvm-s0a, then pvm-s0b (2.0 compatibility; engine option; sequential because both edit polars_df.py)
3. pvm-s1 (versions and correctness; a guaranteed version failing is a stop)
4. pvm-s2 (SF10 feasibility; the user approves the run budget)
5. pvm-s3a (can start after pvm-d0), then pvm-s3b (tooling; DuckDB output unchanged)
6. pvm-s4 (run)
7. pvm-s5 (analysis)
8. pvm-d1 (the user chooses the publication scope; can be decided at any time), then pvm-s6 and pvm-s6b

Global guardrails:
- Never install non-lock Polars versions into the main checkout's environment; use a separate worktree and environment.
- Do not bump uv.lock or the pyproject polars floor as part of this work.
- One query code path for all versions: no version branches or shims.
- Fix decision rules (correctness, abort, mover, no-rerun) in code before timed runs.
- Raw data stays outside the repository.
- No speed claims against DuckDB.
- Stage files explicitly; no git add -A.

Out of scope, as separate follow-ups if wanted:
- Rerunning DuckDB TPC-H SF10 with the fixed generator, to restore those seven unranked bundles.
- A DataFrame validation provider that would make Polars bundles rankable (see pvm-d1 option c).
